title: Tech Stack Signal Reader
one_line: Detect which tools a company runs from its own website and turn the stack into a qualification and an angle.
description: Detect which tools a company runs from its own website and turn the stack into a qualification and an angle. Use when someone wants to know what CRM or sequencer or analytics a company uses, wants to find companies on a competitor, or wants tech stack based targeting.
paragraph: A detected tool is a fact; a useful signal is what the tool implies. This skill detects the stack from the live site, then reads it three ways: what it qualifies, what it disqualifies, and what it says about the company's maturity, which is usually the most useful of the three.

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: gtm-tech-stack-signal-scraper 0.015 USD per company.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
